Run ./gradlew :solr:packaging:integrationTests --tests test_secure_example.bats; retain fresh output/XML and identify EOF, no, whitespace, quoted-empty, Enter and --no-prompt behavior, listener paths and password creation checks.
Run ./gradlew tidy with clean tree afterward, and ./gradlew check -x test; report any formatting change for a new exact-head gate.

On a disposable worktree mutate only password creation umask 077 to 022 and require the BATS creation interception to fail; retain fresh output. Interceptor is specific to touch-based creation.

Lifecycle probes on isolated disposable installations: start TLS-enabled embedded ZooKeeper with a shared include, demonstrate a co-located node and CLI client connect, then use the same include with a different plaintext external ensemble. Capture actual connection result and effective nonsecret JVM properties. Also rotate keystore/truststore locations and port and restart; record which zoo.cfg and include values remain stale and whether server and clients connect. Include existing user-managed secureClientPort/zoo.cfg and non-writable include cases. Do not expose passwords or modify real deployments.

Record commands, setup, exact heads, return codes, counts, fresh evidence and recommended smallest safe implementation boundary. Label the gate incomplete while lifecycle defects remain unresolved; do not post publicly.
unresolved: TLS option persistence after rotation and inheritance for external ZooKeeper remain unresolved. Investigation or a passed focused leg does not make this patch ready.
